_doc: Fourteen kinds of person you meet outside a town. A wanderer is one encounter: a body on or near a road, at a landmark, or at a fire after dark. `where` is scored against the spot, `when` against the clock, `wants`/`gives` are what the talk is FOR. They speak through Lingo and are drawn with the existing 2D-avatar to Chibi 2 pipeline, so nothing new is needed to render or voice them. Original names only.

kinds.name: Pedlar
kinds.blurb: A pack, a stick, and three things nobody in town will sell you.
lines: Everything here has walked further than you have. That is the price.
I do not haggle on the road. Too easy to be robbed twice.

kinds.name: Courier
kinds.blurb: Walking fast, looking back, carrying something sealed.
lines: I do not stop. If you want to talk, keep up.
There is a letter and there is a road and they are both somebody else's business.

kinds.name: Hedge-witch
kinds.blurb: Knee-deep in something, and not surprised to see you.
lines: Bring me three of the grey-stemmed sort and I will do you a kindness.
It will wear off. Everything does.

kinds.name: Bounty Poster
kinds.blurb: A board on a post, and someone whose whole job is the board.
lines: Read it. Do not tear it down, it took me an hour.
The ones with two names on them are the ones to leave alone.

kinds.name: Refugee
kinds.blurb: Carrying too much of the wrong things, going the other way.
lines: Do not go up that way. There is nothing up that way now.
If you are going anyway — there is a cellar, and there is a key under the step.

kinds.name: Surveyor
kinds.blurb: A tripod, a long brass thing, and a great deal of paper.
lines: Stand where I tell you and count to twenty. That is the whole job.
A place is not a place until somebody writes it down.

kinds.name: Hermit
kinds.blurb: A long way from any road, and not lost.
lines: I have not spoken to anyone since the frost. Forgive the rust.
There is something buried a hundred paces that way. I have never wanted it.

kinds.name: Mercenary Captain
kinds.blurb: Four tents, a cookfire, and a price list.
lines: Coin first. Everyone says they are good for it and most of them are dead.
One zone. After that we renegotiate or we part friends.

kinds.name: Toll-keeper
kinds.blurb: A chain across the road and a chair beside it.
lines: Six coin. Four if you are carrying nothing worth taking.
You can ford it downstream. People drown doing that.

kinds.name: Minstrel
kinds.blurb: At somebody else's fire, as usual.
lines: I heard what you did at the crossing. I have made it worse and put a tune on it.
Give me a week and this will be a song people get wrong.

kinds.name: Poacher
kinds.blurb: Very still, until you are past.
lines: You did not see me and I did not see you, and we are both better for it.
Hides. Cheap, and do not ask whose land they walked on.

kinds.name: Relic Hunter
kinds.blurb: Kitted out, impatient, and eyeing the same door you are.
lines: I was here first. That is not a threat, it is a fact about time.
Whoever gets to the bottom takes the box. Agreed?

kinds.name: Wounded Patroller
kinds.blurb: Propped against something, and not going any further on that leg.
lines: The rest of them are further up. Do not look at their faces.
Water. Then tell somebody at the post, if you are going that way.

names._doc: Given names for the people you meet on the road, so a job reads "Tolvi is missing somebody" and not "Mercenary Captain is missing somebody". Original, and deliberately plain — these are working people, not heroes.
